about.title: About Business Loan Calculator - Commercial Financing Tool
about.description: The Business Loan Calculator helps entrepreneurs and business owners estimate monthly payments, total interest costs, and loan terms for commercial financing. Whether you're reviewing working capital, equipment financing, or expansion funding, this calculator provides payment estimates and supports side-by-side comparison of different loan scenarios.

faq.q: What types of business loans can I calculate?
faq.a: This calculator works for various business loans including term loans, SBA loans, equipment financing, working capital loans, and commercial real estate loans. Simply input the loan amount, interest rate, and term.

faq.q: How do I qualify for better business loan rates?
faq.a: Lenders often review business credit, cash flow, time in business, financial statements, collateral, and industry risk when pricing loans. Qualification standards vary by lender and loan type.

faq.q: Should I choose a shorter or longer loan term?
faq.a: Shorter terms usually mean higher monthly payments and lower total interest, while longer terms usually reduce monthly payments and increase total cost. Use the calculator to compare those tradeoffs against your cash flow assumptions.

faq.q: What's the difference between SBA and conventional business loans?
faq.a: SBA and conventional business loans can differ in rate, term length, collateral requirements, fee structure, and approval process. Review current lender terms directly because these differences vary across programs and market conditions.
